instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Your task is to create a Verilog module that implements a one-hot state machine. 
A one-hot state machine is a type of digital circuit that uses a set of flip-flops to store the current state of the machine. 
Each flip-flop represents one state, and only one flip-flop is set to 1 at any given time. 
The outputs of the circuit are determined by the current state of the machine.

Your module should have the following inputs and outputs:

Inputs: a clock signal (clk)
Outputs: a set of n output signals (out1, out2, ..., outn)
The module should also have the following parameters:

n: the number of states in the machine
Your module should implement the following functionality:

The circuit should have n flip-flops, each representing one state in the machine.
Only one flip-flop should be set to 1 at any given time, representing the current state of the machine.
The outputs of the circuit should be determined by the current state of the machine.
To implement the one-hot state machine, you should use Verilog code to define the flip-flops and their connections to the outputs. 
You should also use Verilog code to define the state transitions, which determine which flip-flop is set to 1 at any given time.
You should use the clock signal to synchronize the state transitions of the machine.
